meta.title: Career Sim
meta.description: Play out your possible career paths before you live them.

home.title: Play out your next career before you live it
home.subtitle: Upload your CV, pick where you want to go (or go in blind), and simulate the years ahead: reskilling, relocation, setbacks and wins. Then see how to reframe your CV for the path you liked.

pillars.title: Linear and non-linear paths
pillars.body: Climb your current ladder, or jump sideways using the skills you already have.

pillars.title: Emerging and hands-on roles
pillars.body: AI-anything, UGC and creator careers, or a downshift into a trade, with honest reskilling timelines.

pillars.title: A CV that matches your path
pillars.body: The game learns where you're heading and suggests what to highlight in your CV.

explore.title: Career transitions
explore.intro: Pick a starting role to see where your skills can take you. Overlap shows how much of the target role's skill set you already cover.
explore.noGaps: No gaps: you already cover this role's skills.
explore.licensed: Requires a licence or apprenticeship (varies by country)
explore.draftNote: Draft data: skill profiles and learning times are rough placeholders for review, not researched figures.
